Jayce|jgl.identity: Two-form fighter, played in the jungle about one game in five. In hammer form, To the Skies! (Q) leaps onto a target, Lightning Field (W) burns around him and Thundering Blow (E) knocks back; in cannon form, Shock Blast (Q) sped up by Acceleration Gate (E) pokes from afar and Hyper Charge (W) speeds up his attacks. Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer (R) swaps forms from level 1.
Jayce|jgl.playstyle: Early-game poke jungler: aggressive ganks, invades and pressure before objectives. He has to win early; late game, his impact drops sharply.
Jayce|jgl.early_game: Clear by switching forms to chain abilities. Gank from level 3: hammer Q to leap, hammer E to knock the target toward your laner, then cannon form and Q + E to finish. Before objectives, poke in cannon form to wear down the enemy team.
Jayce|jgl.level_1: Q first. The hammer leap helps on camps; the cannon poke helps in skirmishes.
Jayce|jgl.level_2: W. Hyper Charge (cannon) for clearing, or Lightning Field (hammer) for area damage.
Jayce|jgl.level_3: E. Thundering Blow (hammer) knocks the target back: aim it toward your laner or your tower. Acceleration Gate (cannon) speeds up your Shock Blast. First gank possible.
Jayce|jgl.level_6: No ultimate to unlock: your transformation ranks up automatically, which empowers the first attack after each form swap. It's mostly when your laners have their ultimates for your ganks.
power_spikes: First completed item: very strong poke and burst.
Two items: your last big spike before the late game.
Before objectives: poke that wears down the enemy team.
Jayce|jgl.jungle_plan: Fast clear and aggressive ganks from level 3. Jayce has to build his lead early: invades with your laners, Scuttle control, dives. Before every objective (Void Grubs around 8 minutes, dragons), poke the enemy team in cannon form to force them back. Don't play for the late game: convert your lead before 20 minutes.
Jayce|jgl.trading: Ganking: hammer Q → hammer E toward your laner → cannon form → Q + E. Skirmishing: poke first, then go in to finish. Give up on it against tanks who lock you down (Rammus) or junglers who kite you (Nidalee).
threats: Nidalee, Zyra and junglers who poke you or beat you from range.
mistakes: Knocking the target away from your laner with hammer E.
Staying in hammer form in the middle of the enemy team.
Farming passively instead of building a lead.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: You're both early-game junglers: be faster on ganks.
matchup_notes.Graves: He beats you in duels: gank where he isn't.
matchup_notes.Sylas: Poke him in cannon form before he sticks to you.
matchup_notes.Nidalee: She farms faster and pokes you: play with your laners.
matchup_notes.Rammus: His taunt and armor shut you down: avoid him.

Jayce|jgl.mid_game: Poke and siege before objectives. Play with your team to convert your lead.
Jayce|jgl.late_game: Poke from range before fights and finish low targets. Avoid committing in hammer form.
Jayce|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler and take objectives quickly.
Jayce|jgl.behind: Poke safely and play with your team: your scaling is limited.
Jayce|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to build an early lead through ganks and turn it into objectives before the late game.
Jayce|jgl.final_tip: With Thundering Blow, always knock the target toward your laner or your tower, never away from them.
